'''Leezeldafuzz Lee's Agents of Black Sun Deck''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Leezeldafuzz]]
* '''Published:''' 10 April 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]

* '''Strategy:''' Agents Of Black Sun

== Strategy ==

When I made the deck, I didn't know that the deployment restriction was in effect for the whole game. I thought if you flipped it, it went away. Now I guess I'll go back to my Carbon Chamber Testing/My Favorite Decoration Deck.

When I finish, I'll repost it.

:)
